name: Give_1
short_caption: The robot opens both arms wide with palms up in an offering or welcoming gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral rest posture, the robot briefly retracts its hands toward its lower waist. It then sweeps both arms forward and outward in a smooth arc, presenting its open palms facing upward. The robot holds this open-handed posture momentarily before smoothly lowering its arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot extends both arms forward and outward; ensure the immediate front and lateral space is clear of visitors.
